Announcing Rust 1.97.0

July 9, 2026 · The Rust Release Team

The Rust team is happy to announce a new version of Rust, 1.97.0.

If you have a previous version installed via rustup, you can update with:

$ rustup update stable

What is in 1.97.0 stable

  • One repaired list item
  • A second item with release details
